queries.expr: {service_name="security-manager-v2",environment="validation",schema_version="1",job="devsecops-security-v2"} | json eventType="eventType", projectId="projectId", runId="runId", resultDigest="resultDigest", artifactDigest="artifactDigest", executionStatus="executionStatus", policyDecision="policyDecision", evaluationCount="evaluationCount", findingCount="findingCount", findingCountKnown="findingCountKnown", highSeverityFindingCount="highSeverityFindingCount", highSeverityCountKnown="highSeverityCountKnown", consumerId="consumerId", deliveryStatus="deliveryStatus", deliveryOrigin="deliveryOrigin", errorCategory="errorCategory", sourceClassification="sourceClassification", timestamp="timestamp", pluginId="pluginId" | __error__="" | projectId=${project:json} | runId=${run:json} | eventType="PLUGIN_RESULT"
queries.purpose: Execution state and Policy decision remain separate JSON fields; REPLAY, not a new scan.

queries.expr: sum by (policy_decision) (max by (plugin, policy_decision) (max_over_time({service_name="security-manager-v2",environment="validation",schema_version="1",job="devsecops-security-v2"} | json eventType="eventType", projectId="projectId", runId="runId", resultDigest="resultDigest", artifactDigest="artifactDigest", executionStatus="executionStatus", policyDecision="policyDecision", evaluationCount="evaluationCount", findingCount="findingCount", findingCountKnown="findingCountKnown", highSeverityFindingCount="highSeverityFindingCount", highSeverityCountKnown="highSeverityCountKnown", consumerId="consumerId", deliveryStatus="deliveryStatus", deliveryOrigin="deliveryOrigin", errorCategory="errorCategory", sourceClassification="sourceClassification", timestamp="timestamp", pluginId="pluginId" | __error__="" | projectId=${project:json} | runId=${run:json} | eventType="PLUGIN_RESULT" | policy_decision!="NONE" | unwrap evaluationCount | __error__="" [$__range])))
queries.purpose: One completed evaluation per plugin in exact selected project/run; duplicate deliveries do not increase counts.

queries.expr: max by (plugin) (max_over_time({service_name="security-manager-v2",environment="validation",schema_version="1",job="devsecops-security-v2"} | json eventType="eventType", projectId="projectId", runId="runId", resultDigest="resultDigest", artifactDigest="artifactDigest", executionStatus="executionStatus", policyDecision="policyDecision", evaluationCount="evaluationCount", findingCount="findingCount", findingCountKnown="findingCountKnown", highSeverityFindingCount="highSeverityFindingCount", highSeverityCountKnown="highSeverityCountKnown", consumerId="consumerId", deliveryStatus="deliveryStatus", deliveryOrigin="deliveryOrigin", errorCategory="errorCategory", sourceClassification="sourceClassification", timestamp="timestamp", pluginId="pluginId" | __error__="" | projectId=${project:json} | runId=${run:json} | eventType="PLUGIN_RESULT" | findingCountKnown="true" | unwrap findingCount | __error__="" [$__range]))
queries.purpose: Native count only. Disabled/error/not-scanned/Cosign produce no value, never zero.

queries.expr: max by (plugin) (max_over_time({service_name="security-manager-v2",environment="validation",schema_version="1",job="devsecops-security-v2"} | json eventType="eventType", projectId="projectId", runId="runId", resultDigest="resultDigest", artifactDigest="artifactDigest", executionStatus="executionStatus", policyDecision="policyDecision", evaluationCount="evaluationCount", findingCount="findingCount", findingCountKnown="findingCountKnown", highSeverityFindingCount="highSeverityFindingCount", highSeverityCountKnown="highSeverityCountKnown", consumerId="consumerId", deliveryStatus="deliveryStatus", deliveryOrigin="deliveryOrigin", errorCategory="errorCategory", sourceClassification="sourceClassification", timestamp="timestamp", pluginId="pluginId" | __error__="" | projectId=${project:json} | runId=${run:json} | eventType="PLUGIN_RESULT" | highSeverityCountKnown="true" | unwrap highSeverityFindingCount | __error__="" [$__range]))
queries.purpose: Only known native HIGH/CRITICAL. Gitleaks has no native severity; Semgrep ERROR is not silently HIGH.

queries.expr: {service_name="security-manager-v2",environment="validation",schema_version="1",job="devsecops-security-v2"} | json eventType="eventType", projectId="projectId", runId="runId", resultDigest="resultDigest", artifactDigest="artifactDigest", executionStatus="executionStatus", policyDecision="policyDecision", evaluationCount="evaluationCount", findingCount="findingCount", findingCountKnown="findingCountKnown", highSeverityFindingCount="highSeverityFindingCount", highSeverityCountKnown="highSeverityCountKnown", consumerId="consumerId", deliveryStatus="deliveryStatus", deliveryOrigin="deliveryOrigin", errorCategory="errorCategory", sourceClassification="sourceClassification", timestamp="timestamp", pluginId="pluginId" | __error__="" | projectId=${project:json} | runId=${run:json} | eventType="PLUGIN_RESULT" | executionStatus=~"DISABLED|SKIPPED|NOT_CONFIGURED|UNSUPPORTED|ERROR|POLICY_ERROR"
queries.purpose: Absence of a row is no observation, not PASS.

queries.expr: {service_name="security-manager-v2",environment="validation",schema_version="1",job="devsecops-security-v2"} | json eventType="eventType", projectId="projectId", runId="runId", resultDigest="resultDigest", artifactDigest="artifactDigest", executionStatus="executionStatus", policyDecision="policyDecision", evaluationCount="evaluationCount", findingCount="findingCount", findingCountKnown="findingCountKnown", highSeverityFindingCount="highSeverityFindingCount", highSeverityCountKnown="highSeverityCountKnown", consumerId="consumerId", deliveryStatus="deliveryStatus", deliveryOrigin="deliveryOrigin", errorCategory="errorCategory", sourceClassification="sourceClassification", timestamp="timestamp", pluginId="pluginId" | __error__="" | projectId=${project:json} | runId=${run:json} | eventType="CONSUMER_DELIVERY"
queries.purpose: Show Dojo/Loki receipt states and MOCK_HTTP/DRY_RUN/LOCAL_ONLY origin. No claim of real remote ACK.

queries.expr: {service_name="security-manager-v2",environment="validation",schema_version="1",job="devsecops-security-v2"} | json eventType="eventType", projectId="projectId", runId="runId", resultDigest="resultDigest", artifactDigest="artifactDigest", executionStatus="executionStatus", policyDecision="policyDecision", evaluationCount="evaluationCount", findingCount="findingCount", findingCountKnown="findingCountKnown", highSeverityFindingCount="highSeverityFindingCount", highSeverityCountKnown="highSeverityCountKnown", consumerId="consumerId", deliveryStatus="deliveryStatus", deliveryOrigin="deliveryOrigin", errorCategory="errorCategory", sourceClassification="sourceClassification", timestamp="timestamp", pluginId="pluginId" | __error__="" | projectId=${project:json} | eventType="PLUGIN_RESULT"
queries.purpose: Selected project across runs; 200-row limit. Repeated rows are deliveries, not independent scans.

queries.expr: {service_name="security-manager-v2",environment="validation",schema_version="1",job="devsecops-security-v2"} | json eventType="eventType", projectId="projectId", runId="runId", resultDigest="resultDigest", artifactDigest="artifactDigest", executionStatus="executionStatus", policyDecision="policyDecision", evaluationCount="evaluationCount", findingCount="findingCount", findingCountKnown="findingCountKnown", highSeverityFindingCount="highSeverityFindingCount", highSeverityCountKnown="highSeverityCountKnown", consumerId="consumerId", deliveryStatus="deliveryStatus", deliveryOrigin="deliveryOrigin", errorCategory="errorCategory", sourceClassification="sourceClassification", timestamp="timestamp", pluginId="pluginId" | __error__="" | projectId=${project:json} | (runId=${run:json} or resultDigest=${resultDigest:json})
queries.purpose: Exact run or digest match, within project. No source snippets or secrets.
